question: Should Skill Workshop add this core `review` action and bind pending lifecycle approvals to the proposal version captured by the approval prompt?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but it establishes new core operator UX and intentionally changes stale pending-approval behavior; repository evidence does not show explicit owner acceptance of that permanent contract.

options.title: Accept the full contract
options.body: Land canonical previews and version-bound pending approvals after rebasing and refreshing exact-head validation.

options.title: Narrow to preview only
options.body: Keep the read-only review action but defer approval-snapshot binding if owners do not want stale prompts to fail closed yet.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Leave current inspect and lifecycle behavior unchanged until a smaller operator-review contract is agreed.

recommendation.title: Accept the full contract
recommendation.body: Land canonical previews and version-bound pending approvals after rebasing and refreshing exact-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: Release history identifies this person as the primary owner of the built-in Skill Workshop lifecycle and approval behavior.
